Class ReportsDAO

java.lang.Object
com.sharetea.dao.ReportsDAO
public class ReportsDAO extends Object
Runs the read-only queries behind the manager reports: trends, top sellers, inventory status, product usage, the X-Report and the sales report.

Each report's results come back in a small nested data class. Date ranges cover whole days, from midnight on the start date to 23:59:59 on the end date. Methods log database errors and return empty results instead of throwing.

  • Method Details

    • getMaxOrderDate

      public LocalDate getMaxOrderDate()
      Finds the date of the most recent order. Reports use it as "today", since the sample data ends before the real current date.
      Returns:
      the date of the latest order, or today's date if there are no orders or the query fails

    • getTrendsKpis

      public ReportsDAO.TrendsKpis getTrendsKpis(LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate)

      Parameters:

      endDate - last day of the range

    • getDailySales

      public Map<String,Double> getDailySales(LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate)
      Adds up sales for each day in a date range, for the revenue chart.
      Parameters:
      startDate - first day of the range
      endDate - last day of the range
      Returns:
      sales in dollars keyed by yyyy-MM-dd, earliest day first; days with no orders are left out
